methods.label: Find the remaining share
methods.explanation:
All the students together represent \(1\). Since the walking students are the remaining group, subtract the bus, automobile, and bicycle fractions from \(1\). Using twentieths gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
1-\left(\frac12+\frac14+\frac1{10}\right)
&=\frac{20}{20}-\left(\frac{10}{20}+\frac5{20}+\frac2{20}\right)\\
&=\frac3{20}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore \(\frac3{20}\) of the students walk home, choice B.
